# Registered product folders (one per line).
# The product-isolation CI guard (.github/workflows/product-isolation.yml)
# fails any PR that touches more than one of these folders, enforcing the
# PRODUCTS.md one-product-per-branch rule.
#
# Adding a new product? Add its top-level folder name here (step in
# PRODUCTS.md "Adding a new product"). The guard auto-detects unregistered
# product-like folders (any new top-level dir containing index.md) and
# blocks them until registered, so this list cannot silently rot.
